note: An axis-less group has no axis to carry a flat coordinate, so the build drops a member's value and label. Only the second member sets one. Allowed twin: group-member-shapes-load, whose `axes = []` umbrella lists bare variables.
fails_if: the register loader accepts a flat `value`/`label` on a member of an `axes = []` group, which the build then drops

message_contains: an axis-less group (`axes = []`) lists whole members
